## Decision log

#Decision #1: ggspatial Using this "ggspatial" it made it easier to see and know the relationships between the locations and data.

#Decision #2: Different ways to view data Using ggplot2 and geom_sf made it so that we could see the data in a clean way and leaflet so we could play with the data by being able to zoom and see all the features the maps offer.
